title: visual loudness primary secondary tertiary
rule: Visual loudness is a named three-level scale: primary / secondary / tertiary so designers can balance visual priority. Dual-cite Actions one-primary; this row is the three-loudness scale, not a second “one primary” rule.
pass_when: Button variants on a view map to primary / secondary / tertiary loudness; one primary remains the dual-cite cap.
fail_when: All actions share the same loudness with no primary/secondary/tertiary distinction, claimed as this GOLD scale.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: Actions one-primary as this three-level row; Next vs Save-progress pairing as this scale.
